versions.content: If frames with a payload <= 8 (either CAN 2.0 frames or small CAN FD frames) are used for a Rx N - SDU and CanTpRxPaddi ngActivation is equal to CANTP_ON , then CanTp receives by means of CanTp_RxIndication() call an SF Rx N - PDU belonging to that N - SDU, with a length smaller than eight bytes (i.e. PduInfoPtr.SduLength < 8), CanTp shall reject the reception . T he runtime error code CANTP_E_PADDING shall be reported to the Default Error Tracer .
